title: Bound evidence-carrier validation Git queries independently of directory history
outcome: Bound evidence-carrier validation Git queries independently of directory history
acceptance: Full evidence-carrier validation uses bounded aggregate tree reads rather than one Git subprocess per origin or prefix directory, while preserving directory and ordinary-blob path/mode refusals.
Behavioral coverage shows the query work remains bounded as unrelated evidence origins/prefixes grow and no pack payload is opened solely for carrier validation.
